Exploring Water Quality

Functions to summarise water quality data and create plots for further analysis.

summarise_exceedance()
Summarise how often water samples exceed a bacteria threshold after rain
compare_sites()
Compare swim sites by how much rain changes their water quality
plot_exceedance()
Plot the share of unsafe samples in each rainfall band

Bacteria samples from Sydney swim sites, with recent rainfall
